user-summary-candidate: Added transactional work-index for gateway control-plane recovery, ensuring stale dispatch entries are quarantined and phase transitions are validated.

technical-summary: SH14 (C7 repair): comprehensive review and repair. CRITICAL FIX: threaded service_root into admit_record so work-index entry is written during durable admission before queued request can become invisible to recovery. Added owner fencing on phase transitions (claimed→running, running→terminal-cleanup) with CON-AGW-106 error. Fixed recovery of admitted-but-unclaimed requests: transition_recovered_terminal now accepts None stale_epoch to skip ownership check for unclaimed requests, producing replay-required (CON-AGW-102) instead of being cleared silently. Path 1/Path 2 recovery separation: active-work entries (hashed filenames) processed by Path 1, work-index entries (req_*.json) by Path 2, with skip logic to avoid overlap. Added filename/body identity validation in validate_work_index_entry. Comprehensive crash/fault injection tests covering all write windows (admission, claim, start, terminal, cleanup). Fixed _read_raw_entry quarantine path resolution.
user-summary-candidate: Comprehensive repair of gateway work-index: admission writes index at durable point, owner fencing on phase transitions, admitted-but-unclaimed requests properly recovered as replay-required, filename/body identity validation, and full crash-window test coverage.

technical-summary: Rebound the three delegated worker agent profiles from the OpenCode provider to the existing Pi provider/harness while preserving profile IDs, model IDs, concurrency, retry, and stream settings.
user-summary-candidate: Future gateway worker requests now use the Pi harness for all three worker profiles.

technical-summary: Added Pi ACP launch adapter that resolves the pi-acp bridge exclusively from the managed harness runtime, forwards project cwd/model, and fails with an actionable RES-PIACP-001 error when the bridge is absent. Added focused registration, launch-shape, and missing-runtime tests.
user-summary-candidate: Pi now has a managed-runtime ACP launch adapter with focused tests; it still requires the SH16 provisioning recipe and isolation decision before production gateway execution.

technical-summary: Moved Pi CLI and MCP adapter package identities into the declarative pi.yaml harness recipe; installer now consumes those recipe values with backward-compatible defaults and records the declared audiagentic[acp] runtime extra. Added focused recipe parsing/default tests. No ACP adapter implementation or live package install was added.
user-summary-candidate: SH16 provisioning now declares Pi's managed CLI, MCP adapter, and ACP runtime extra in the harness recipe so audiagentic install remains the installation path.

technical-summary: Research-validated Pi ACP provisioning: npm pi-acp@0.0.31 exists with bin pi-acp and repository svkozak/pi-acp. Added it to the managed Pi recipe and installer, pinned pi-mcp-adapter to 2.11.0 instead of latest, and retained the managed-runtime-only ACP adapter and unchanged no-isolation policy.
user-summary-candidate: Pi ACP now references a real pinned community bridge and no longer relies on an unpinned MCP adapter version; production execution still requires the existing isolation decision.

technical-summary: Implemented request-local Pi ACP launch state. Gateway dispatch passes <request-dir>/runtime to the public ACP preparation seam; Pi sets PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR and explicit --session-dir under request-local pi paths, and on Windows redirects HOME, USERPROFILE, HOMEDRIVE/HOMEPATH, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, TEMP/TMP and XDG config/cache/data/state paths in the child AcpLaunch environment. Existing process environment is not mutated and provider isolation tier is unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Pi ACP sessions now receive distinct request-local agent and session state roots, including Windows home/temp/config redirects; this does not yet claim filesystem or security isolation.

technical-summary: Added reusable Pi request-runtime layout with manifest, request-local agent/session/temp/cache/home paths, config materialization, cleanup, and quarantine hooks. Runner environment can consume AUDIAGENTIC_PI_REQUEST_ROOT while preserving project cwd and shared project .audiagentic/mcp.json semantics. No sandbox or provider isolation changes.
user-summary-candidate: SH16 now has request-local Pi state management with explicit manifest and cleanup/quarantine hooks.

technical-summary: Integrated Pi request-runtime creation into sessionful gateway dispatch before prepare_provider_acp_launch, using the request id and managed harness config at the provider's existing runtime/pi root. Added cleanup for cancellation and one-shot successful terminal paths, quarantine for ACP/setup AudiaGenticError, and dispatch tests proving materialization and quarantine. Keep-alive runtime roots remain for the live session lifecycle; provider isolation tier unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: SH16 Pi ACP dispatch now receives a materialized request-local runtime before launch, with tested cleanup/quarantine behavior and preserved project cwd/shared MCP semantics.

technical-summary: Closed SH07 reviews RV744/RV745/RV746: wait_llm_request timeout path now reads live session-turn evidence (shared _latest_session_turn_event helper) instead of defaulting to phase=launching; GatewayServiceHost.create loads and installs the gateway-owned profile registry from a machine-scoped gateway-profiles.yaml at startup so shared-mode queue limits are registry-authoritative from the first request; registered the missing CON-AGW-106 owner-epoch-fencing error code that was masking passing C7 admission-before-claim tests, and added a digest-mismatch quarantine regression test.

user-summary-candidate: Fixed Pi worker isolation so gateway requests do not load user-global extensions while still receiving the managed custom model registry.

technical-summary: Added a Docker-gated production crash-matrix test suite (AUDIAGENTIC_GATEWAY_CRASH_MATRIX_DOCKER=1) that launches the gateway service as a real OS subprocess, submits requests through a genuine local-openai HTTP call to a local rig, SIGKILLs the process at phases observed from the on-disk work-index/record files, and restarts against the same service-root to prove recovery reaches the correct terminal state (admission-before-claim, mid-attempt crash, cancel-race, and malformed-entry quarantine) — verified passing twice in the built image. Also changed adapters/opencode/execution_environment.py to raise CFG-OPENC-002 instead of silently letting a project with no declared providers fall back to the machine's global OpenCode whitelist, the mechanism behind an earlier incident.
user-summary-candidate: The shared gateway's crash-recovery behavior is now proven against a real killed-and-restarted service process, not just simulated in-process, and OpenCode launches now fail loudly instead of silently borrowing an unrelated global provider list when a project forgets to declare its own.

technical-summary: Implemented pure deterministic terminal output quality classifier (AS36). Module agents_terminal_quality.py with TerminalQualityLabel enum, TerminalQualitySignal/Report frozen dataclasses, and classify_terminal_output() function. Covers 10 signal types: TQ-NO-OUTPUT, TQ-ENDS-WITH-PREAMBLE, TQ-MISSING-EXPECTED-CLOSEOUT, TQ-UNTERMINATED-MARKDOWN, TQ-REPETITION, TQ-DROPPED-EVENTS, TQ-HIGH-EVENT-LOW-OUTPUT, TQ-STOP-REASON, TQ-TOOL-AFTER-LAST-TEXT. 50 unit tests covering all signals, label aggregation, confidence scoring, SH07 incident shape, and redaction guarantees.
user-summary-candidate: Added deterministic terminal-output quality classifier for live agent requests (AS36). Diagnostic only — no request state changes.

technical-summary: Added clear_expired_quarantine_entries(service_root, *, max_age_seconds) to agents_gateway_work_index.py, called opportunistically from agents_gateway_recovery.recover_gateway_requests(); mtime-based sweep touches only the quarantine directory, never active-work entries. 6 new tests (TestQuarantineBoundedRetention) plus full module regression (22/22) verified passing independently before closing SH17.
user-summary-candidate: The gateway's quarantine directory for malformed recovery entries no longer grows without bound — old entries are now swept on a retention window during recovery.

technical-summary: SH15 (shared-gateway plan): Wire richer progress summary through wait_llm_request timeout path. Previously, request_runtime_status included the SH15 progress_summary (event-kind-counts, tool counts, dropped-events, callback-health) but wait_llm_request timeout responses did not — they only had latest_session_event. Now both callers pass the full progress_summary from build_session_progress_summary(), so wait/status/diagnostics all surface the same richer evidence: event-kind-counts, active/completed/failed tool counts, assistant/thought chunk counts and bytes, stop-reason, dropped-events/total-events counters, callback-disabled health flag. Added regression tests for build_session_progress_summary (event-kind-counts, tool status tracking, dropped events, callback health, stop-reason, request-id filtering, tool status transitions), project_request_progress with progress_summary (richer fields included, backward compat), wait_llm_request timeout path, and request_runtime_status SH15 summary.
user-summary-candidate: SH15: wait timeout now includes richer session progress (tool counts, event counts, dropped events, callback health) matching status/diagnostics.
